newsitem.title: UK: Halifax takes new BT system.
newsitem.headline: Halifax takes new BT system.

text.p: Britain's Halifax Building Society said on Monday that British Telecommunications was to provide it with a new multi-media communications network costing 130 million stg.

Under a five year contract, the new service would be introduced into the society's network of around 1,000 branches across the UK over the next six months and into its 650 estate agency offices later in 1997, Halifax said in a statement.
Halifax will use BT's new asynchronous transfer mode (ATM).

"Halifax is the first financial institution to use this type of technology and this agreement demonstrates our commitment to providing high quaility customer service and ensures we can adapt quickly to changing customer and business needs," said Halifax chief executive Mike Blackburn.
